components.name: Primary Signal Keycap
components.description: Primary safety-orange mechanical keycap CTA with 3px press travel.
components.css: .ds-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.58em; min-height: 3.1rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.3rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', sans-serif); font-weight: 660; font-size: 1rem; font-stretch: 112%; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 90ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 150ms; } .ds-key svg { width: 1.08em; height: 1.08em; } .ds-key--accent { color: #1a0d06; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff7a45, #ff5a1f 72%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55), inset 0 -5px 0 #b8380c, 0 7px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-key:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4), inset 0 -2px 0 #b8380c, 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }

components.name: Bone PBT Keycap
components.description: Secondary warm bone PBT keycap button for calm companion actions.
components.css: .ds-key-bone { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.1rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.3rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', sans-serif); font-weight: 660; font-size: 1rem; font-stretch: 112%; color: #1a1a1c; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #efeadf, #e6e0d2 72%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55), inset 0 -5px 0 #b9b19e, 0 7px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 90ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 0.1), filter 150ms; } .ds-key-bone:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-key-bone:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key-bone:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4), inset 0 -2px 0 #b9b19e, 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }

components.name: Slate Studio Keycap
components.description: Anodized dark slate keycap for expression toggles and secondary links.
components.css: .ds-key-slate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.45rem; padding: 0.48rem 0.9rem 0.72rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', sans-serif); font-weight: 660; font-size: 0.88rem; font-stretch: 112%; color: #ece8df; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4a4f59, #3d414a 72%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12), inset 0 -5px 0 #252830, 0 7px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.65); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 90ms; } .ds-key-slate:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-key-slate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key-slate:active, .ds-key-slate[aria-pressed='true'] { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08), inset 0 -2px 0 #252830, 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }

components.name: Bench Toggle Chip
components.description: Compact monospace toggle chip for switch voices, spring presets, and middleware stages.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-chip { border: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 0.38rem 0.7rem 0.48rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #ece8df; background: #1f2227; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #2b2e35; transition: transform 70ms, background-color 140ms; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #ff5a1f; color: #1a0d06; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #b8380c; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Studio Composer Input
components.description: Dark anodized text input with accessible warm placeholder and signal focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.45rem; } .ds-label { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; color: #ece8df; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.82rem 0.95rem; border-radius: 10px; background: #17191d; border: 1px solid #2b2e35; font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; color: #ece8df; caret-color: #ff5a1f; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9c988f; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #ff5a1f; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio of Sakib Alam Mubin (SA Mubin) treats the browser as a joyful, physical full-stack developer studio rather than a static résumé or dark "cyber hacker" template. Grounded in machined graphite aluminium (#111215) alternating with warm bone PBT keycap fields (#E6E0D2), the world invites visitors to poke, drag, type, and listen from the very first viewport.

An original 3D-vinyl-shaded developer avatar of SA Mubin anchors the hero over a 360-degree cursor-reactive capsule-stroke canvas and peeks upside-down across the curved bone-to-graphite footer seam. Controls behave like real desk hardware: keycaps depress with physical travel and selectable synthesized Web Audio switch voices (Thock, Clicky, Synth), UI motion runs on real Hooke's-law spring solvers, and a comedic roving production bug mutters developer one-liners when discovered.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating Physical Grounds: Full-bleed sections alternate strictly between warm anodized graphite (#111215) and matte bone PBT polymer (#E6E0D2).
Expressive 3D-Clay Avatar & Footer Peeker: Custom multi-gradient SVG character rig with cursor-tracking parallax, Boop / Shades / Say Hi states, kinetic stroke wave, and upside-down footer peek.

Tactile Switch Acoustics & Physics Toys: Selectable mechanical switch profiles (Thock, Clicky, Synth), SAMUBIN desk macropad, and live 60fps Hooke's-law spring playground with zero external audio or 3D bundle files.
Disciplined Typographic Voices: Stretched variable Archivo carries display and human narrative; JetBrains Mono stays strictly inside hardware screens, code benches, and the ⌘K terminal.

rules.name: The Alternating Field Rule
rules.body: Full-width page bands alternate between Anodized Graphite (#111215) and Bone PBT (#e6e0d2), terminating in a curved bone wave seam where SA Mubin peeks upside-down into the dark footer.

rules.name: The Kinetic Color Containment Rule
rules.body: Multi-hue tertiary colors (#38bdf8, #a855f7, #facc15) live exclusively inside dynamic canvas waveforms, oscilloscope traces, and avatar spark accents—never on static page chrome or typography.

rules.name: The Reserved Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears strictly inside code panes, hardware telemetry readouts, keyboard <kbd> legends, and the ⌘K command terminal—never as a decorative "tech" costume on prose, headings, or navigation.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own visual authority; never place small uppercase eyebrow or kicker labels above <h1>, <h2>, or <h3>.

rules.name: The Strict Semantic Bevel Rule
rules.body: Deep bottom-lip inset bevels (inset 0 -5px/-6px 0) belong exclusively to pressable buttons and keycaps that physically depress on click. Static badges, cards, and containers never mimic keycap lips or single-edge accent stripes.

rules.name: The Single-Enclosure Rule
rules.body: Hardware benches (.macropad-shell, .spring-card, .bench, .composer-box) use one outer bordered/shadowed enclosure divided internally by 1px hairlines—never cards nested inside cards.

dos: Do use Sakib Alam Mubin and SA Mubin exclusively as names across all copy, metadata, JSON-LD, and social cards, keeping @thesamubin and @samubin strictly for social/profile handles.
Do keep the alternating #111215 graphite and #e6e0d2 bone section rhythm and single-layer bench enclosures (>= 13px minimum text size and tabular-nums on telemetry).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce across every canvas loop, spring solver, avatar rig, and roving bug animation, and persist the user's mute preference.
donts: Don't use standalone "Mubin", "Syed", or visible SEO alias dumps ("also known as...") anywhere in user-facing or structured copy.
Don't place kickers/eyebrows above headings, nest bordered cards inside bordered cards, or put inset 0 -3px/-4px 0 stripes on non-keycap elements.

Don't let heavy "cybersecurity hacker" tropes dominate the portfolio; lead ~80% with full-stack software engineering and interactive UI craft, keeping XSS/LFI labs strictly as 2 launch buttons in /work/#teaching.
